verdict.rationale: Docs describe cubic generating fixes and pushing them directly to the PR branch (cubic-docs-4), which delivers committable/applicable suggested changes directly in the PR workflow, and users can reply/react to comments (cubic-docs-5, cubic-docs-10). However, there's no explicit mention of a GitHub-native 'one-click apply suggestion' UI element (like GitHub's suggested-change commit button) — the flow described is more automated push-to-branch than an inline click-to-apply diff. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an inline 'Apply suggestion' button/UI, independent/hands-on confirmation of the one-click apply experience.
